attacks.name: Mass Attack
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Leaf Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Jumpluff by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.name: Claydol

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Cosmic Power
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose up to 2 cards from your hand and put them on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. This power can't be used if Claydol is affected by a Special Condition.

text.flavor: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

text.name: Uxie

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Restore
attacks.text: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Knowledge," it is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Flash Bite
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Crobat G from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Toxic Fang
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

text.name: Unown [Q]

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: QUICK
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Unown Q is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to Unown Q and attach Unown Q to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. As long as Unown Q is attached to a Pokémon, you pay {Colorless} less to retreat that Pokémon.

text.flavor: Shaped like ancient writing, it's a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

text.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Psychic Balance
attacks.text: If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch Baltoy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

text.name: Skiploom

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Cotton Balloon
abilities.text: If Skiploom has any {Grass} Energy attached to it, any damage done to Skiploom by attacks from your opponent's Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: Switch Skiploom with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

text.name: Hoppip

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: You may switch Hoppip with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters, but they ?? gentle breezes.

text.name: Unown R

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: RETIRE
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if Unown R is on your Bench, you may discard Unown R and all cards attached to it. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Then, draw a card.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Move any number of basic Energy cards attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

text.name: Judge
effect: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: PlusPower
effect: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn.
If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) (If you choose a Stage 2 Pokémon in your hand, put that Pokémon on the Basic Pokémon instead of on a Stage 1 Pokémon.)

text.name: Luxury Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If any Luxury Ball is in your discard pile, you can't play this card.

text.name: Expert Belt
effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP and that Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). When the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 1 more Prize card.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool rule
rules.text: Attach Expert Belt to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

text.name: Warp Point
effect: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

text.name: Bebe's Search
effect: Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Hoppip

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Cottonweed
abilities.text: If Hoppip has any {Grass} Energy attached to it, the Retreat Cost for Hoppip is 0.

attacks.name: Hover Heal
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions from Hoppip.

text.flavor: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

text.name: Pokémon Collector
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Pokémon Communication
effect: Choose 1 Pokémon in your hand, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Broken Time-Space
effect: Each player may evolve a Pokémon that he or she just played or evolved during that turn.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Night Maintenance
effect: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

text.name: Roseanne's Research
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Basic Pokémon and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
